flags.detail: the physically interesting half of the claim (golden multiplicity -> specific CFT c=7/10, a genuinely physics-flavored observable-central-charge statement) is imported from the literature, not computed; the arc is honest about this ('CITED, not reproduced -- honest'), but the headline framing ('multiplicity selects... flowing (known) to the tricritical Ising CFT') could read as more established-by-this-repo than it is

arc_verdict.json states verdict "PROVED" and a claim_one_line with no hedge, but the arc's own FINDINGS.md explicitly and repeatedly says this is NOT a proof — it is a reduction with a residual open lemma marked 'terminal NEEDS-SPECIALIST'. The verdict file's status field misrepresents the content of the arc it labels.

The arc verdict labels the whole arc PROVED and its one-line claim addresses only H17 (the '5' cascade, which is genuinely verified); but the same FINDINGS.md file also carries H13, an explicitly unproven 'candidate synthesis' extrapolated from only 3 witnesses, and the verdict does not scope PROVED to H17 only or flag H13 as separately unproven.

The central claim rests on the discriminant field of a 2x2 monodromy matrix landing on the same quadratic field ℚ(√2) that also indexes McKay(2O)=E7 — a field-level (type/label) coincidence used to declare E7 'present', explicitly conceded in-arc to be at a different (non-π1-surjection) level than E6's genuine group surjection (B266).

test_five_wall_map_is_one_theorem_not_all_walled and test_every_wall_has_an_open_reframing_or_framework check properties of a WALLS dict authored by the same codebase describing its own open-problem status — this locks the author's self-assessment prose, not an independently derivable fact
